questions.q: В каком положении следует находиться новорождённому при выполнении ИВЛ через мешок-маску?
options: Sniffing position (нейтральное положение шеи с лёгким разгибанием)
questions.explanation: Sniffing position — нейтральное положение шеи с лёгким разгибанием — оптимально для проходимости верхних дыхательных путей. Сильное разгибание/сгибание ухудшает проходимость.

questions.q: При каком ЧСС у новорождённого начинают компрессии грудной клетки?
questions.explanation: По NRP 8 ed. (2021) и МЗ РФ компрессии начинают при ЧСС < 60 уд/мин, несмотря на adequate ИВЛ в течение 30 секунд.

questions.q: Каков соотношение компрессий и вентиляций при СЛР у новорождённого?
questions.explanation: Соотношение 3:1 (90 компрессий + 30 вентиляций в минуту) — стандарт NRP 8 ed. для новорождённых, в отличие от 15:2 у взрослых.

questions.q: Какая начальная доза адреналина при СЛР у новорождённого внутривенно?
questions.explanation: Адреналин 0.01-0.03 мг/кг IV (концентрация 1:10000, или 0.1 мг/мл) каждые 3-5 минут. Эндотрахеально 0.05-0.1 мг/кг (однократно — IV preferred ASAP).

questions.q: Какая начальная FiO₂ для реанимации доношенного новорождённого по NRP 8 ed.?
questions.explanation: 21 % FiO₂ — стандарт для доношенных. Преждевременных < 35 нед: 21-30 %. Концепция избежать гипероксии (free-radical injury). FiO₂ 100 % используется во время компрессий грудной клетки.

questions.q: Какова цель SpO₂ на 1-й минуте жизни (preductal)?
questions.explanation: SpO₂ цели по NRP 8 ed.: 1 мин 60-65 %, 2 мин 65-70 %, 3 мин 70-75 %, 5 мин 80-85 %, 10 мин 85-95 %. Постепенное достижение нормоксемии безопаснее быстрого достижения 100 %.

questions.q: Какая целевая SpO₂ предуктально через 5 минут после рождения у термин-новорождённого по NRP?
questions.explanation: По NRP 8 ed. целевая SpO₂ предуктально: 1 мин 60-65%, 5 мин 80-85%, 10 мин 85-95%. Не делай гипероксии у термин-ребёнка.

questions.q: Какой стартовый FiO₂ для реанимации термин-новорождённого (≥35 нед)?
questions.explanation: У ≥35 нед стартуют с 21% (room air). Для <35 нед — 21-30%. 100% O₂ — только при компрессиях или persistent брадикардии.

questions.q: При длительности pre-ductal SpO₂ < 90% несмотря на effective ИВЛ, что добавляют?
questions.explanation: Если SpO₂ не достигает целевой при adequate ИВЛ — увеличивай FiO₂ до 100%. NRP advises titrate FiO₂ to maintain target saturations.

questions.q: Какова максимальная глубина введения ЭТТ для term-новорождённого 3 кг по правилу 6 + вес?
questions.explanation: NRP правило: глубина ЭТТ от губ = 6 + вес(кг). Для 3 кг = 9 см. Альтернатива: nasotragus length (NTL) + 1.

questions.q: Какой объёмный болюс для гиповолемии у новорождённого при СЛР?
questions.explanation: NRP 8 ed.: 10 мл/кг NaCl 0.9% или эритромасса O Rh- за 5-10 мин IV/IO. Повторить при необходимости. Не использовать альбумин рутинно.

questions.q: Через сколько секунд adequate ИВЛ оценивают эффективность по ЧСС перед эскалацией?
questions.explanation: NRP: оценка ЧСС каждые 30 сек ИВЛ. ЧСС <100 после 30 сек effective ИВЛ → MR SOPA коррекция. ЧСС <60 после 30 сек effective ИВЛ через ЭТТ → компрессии.

questions.q: Что такое MR SOPA в NRP алгоритме?
options: Mask/Reposition Suction Open mouth Pressure increase Airway alternative
Maximize Resuscitation Standard Oxygen Pressure Algorithm
questions.explanation: MR SOPA = Mask adjustment, Reposition airway, Suction, Open mouth, Pressure increase, Airway alternative (LMA/ETT). Корректирующие шаги при не эффективной ИВЛ.

questions.q: У термин-ребёнка с meconium staining без depression — какой первый шаг?
options: Routine care: тёплый, dry, position, suction PRN
questions.explanation: С 2015 NRP routine intubation для meconium НЕ рекомендуется у vigorous baby. Только supportive care. Intubation/aspiration только если non-vigorous + obstructive airway.

questions.q: Какой механизм действия surfactant у новорождённого с RDS?
questions.explanation: Сурфактант (фосфолипидно-белковый комплекс SP-A/B/C/D) снижает поверхностное натяжение в альвеолах, предотвращая их коллапс на выдохе и улучшая compliance.

questions.q: Какой preferred метод введения сурфактанта у новорождённого с RDS на CPAP?
questions.explanation: LISA — preferred 2024 (Aldana-Aguirre Cochrane 2021). Тонкий катетер вводится через голосовые связки на спонтанном CPAP, surfactant вводится медленно, катетер удаляется. ↓ BPD vs INSURE.

questions.q: Антенатальный betamethasone для матери при угрозе преждевременных родов снижает риск:
questions.explanation: Antenatal corticosteroids (betamethasone 12 мг IM × 2 q24h) снижают RDS на 44 %, IVH на 46 %, NEC на 50 %, mortality на 30 % (Roberts Cochrane 2017). Самая эффективная мера профилактики неонатальной заболеваемости.

questions.q: Какой preferred сурфактант для первой дозы у preterm с RDS?
questions.explanation: Poractant alfa 200 мг/кг preferred первая доза (Cochrane 2015 — superior к beractant в mortality 11 % vs 16 %). Subsequent doses 100 мг/кг.

questions.q: При каком FiO₂ на CPAP начинается surfactant у preterm < 28 нед PMA?
questions.explanation: Sweet European Consensus 2023: surfactant indicated у < 28 нед PMA при FiO₂ > 0.30 на CPAP. Для 28-32 нед: FiO₂ > 0.40. Для ≥ 32 нед: FiO₂ > 0.50.

questions.q: Какая оптимальная антенатальная стероидная терапия для матери при риске преждевременных родов 24-34 нед?
options: Бетаметазон 12 мг IM × 2 дозы каждые 24 ч
questions.explanation: ACOG/NICE: бетаметазон 12 мг IM × 2 дозы каждые 24 ч (или дексаметазон 6 мг IM × 4 каждые 12 ч). Снижает RDS, IVH, NEC, смертность.

questions.q: Какая доза poractant alfa (Curosurf) для стартовой surfactant therapy?
questions.explanation: Curosurf стартовая доза 200 мг/кг (2.5 мл/кг). Повторные — 100 мг/кг каждые 12 ч (до 3 доз). Beractant (Survanta) — 100 мг/кг.

questions.q: Главное преимущество LISA (Less Invasive Surfactant Administration) над INSURE?
questions.explanation: LISA доставляет surfactant через тонкий катетер в спонтанно дышащего на CPAP ребёнка — НЕ требует positive-pressure ventilation. Снижает BPD по European Consensus 2022.

questions.q: При каком FiO₂ на CPAP рассматривать surfactant у preterm <32 нед?
questions.explanation: Sweet European Consensus 2022: surfactant при FiO₂ >0.30 на CPAP у GA <26 нед, >0.30 на CPAP у GA ≥ 26 нед — раннее (LISA preferred).

questions.q: Какая classical стадия RDS на рентгенограмме III степени?
options: Air bronchograms за пределы тени сердца
Полное обеднение лёгочного рисунка "белые лёгкие" с air bronchograms
questions.explanation: RDS R-stage III — diffuse opacification ("ground glass"), air bronchograms за пределы сердца, обеднение лёгочного рисунка, нечёткие границы сердца. IV — "белые лёгкие".

questions.q: Каков оптимальный PEEP стартовый при invasive ИВЛ для preterm с RDS?
questions.explanation: PEEP 5-8 cm H₂O стартово (Sweet 2022). Повышай при persistent гипоксии. PEEP <5 → atelectasis, >10 → risk пневмоторакса/обструкции venous return.

questions.q: У ребёнка GA 30 нед с RDS на CPAP FiO₂ 0.40 — что предпочтительнее: bovine vs porcine surfactant?
questions.explanation: Cochrane meta-analysis (Singh 2015): Poractant alfa (Curosurf) 200 мг/кг → reduced mortality vs Beractant 100 мг/кг. Higher dose porcine — superior.

questions.q: Что является показанием к фототерапии у доношенного новорождённого?
options: TSB > 20 мг/дл независимо от часа жизни
TSB > nomogram threshold по часам жизни (AAP 2022)
questions.explanation: AAP 2022 nomograms — TSB threshold зависит от часов жизни (12, 24, 48, 72, 96 ч) + risk factors (HDN, sepsis, GA < 38 нед, asphyxia, hypoalbuminemia). См. neo-bili-2022 калькулятор.

questions.q: Объём DVET (double volume exchange transfusion) у новорождённого:
questions.explanation: DVET = 2 × blood volume = 2 × 80 мл/кг = 160 мл/кг. Эффективность: ↓ TSB ~50 %, удаляет antibodies в случае ABO/Rh isoimmunization.

questions.q: Какова доза IVIG при ABO/Rh isoimmunization с быстро нарастающим TSB?
questions.explanation: IVIG 0.5-1 г/кг IV over 2-4 ч. Mechanism: блокирует Fc-рецепторы на RES → ↓ destruction RBC. Cochrane 2018 — ↓ DVET need 30-50 %.

questions.q: Самая частая форма ГБН по этиологии?
questions.explanation: AB0-incompatibility — самая частая форма ГБН (~30 % всех желтух у term newborns). Mother O + fetus A/B. Обычно лёгкая-средняя тяжесть. Rh-incompatibility реже после anti-D prophylaxis, но severe.

questions.q: Какая частота ABO-несовместимости как причина ГБН в России?
questions.explanation: ABO-несовместимость — 30-40% всех случаев ГБН в РФ. Rh — около 10-15%. Прочие antigens (Kell, Duffy и т.д.) — редко.

questions.q: При TSB на пороге фототерапии по AAP 2022 — в течение какого времени должна быть начата интенсивная PT?
questions.explanation: AAP 2022: при TSB на/около порога DVET начинай интенсивную PT немедленно (within 1 hour) и готовь exchange transfusion если TSB не снижается.

questions.q: Какая доза IVIG при ГБН (Rh или ABO) для предотвращения exchange transfusion?
questions.explanation: IVIG 0.5-1 г/кг IV за 2 ч (повторить через 12 ч PRN). Снижает potreba в DVET у Rh/ABO ГБН с активным гемолизом и подъёмом TSB несмотря на PT.

questions.q: При какой концентрации билирубина рассматривают exchange transfusion у термин-ребёнка по AAP 2022 (escalation tier 1)?
options: TSB ≥ narrow zone от DVET threshold
questions.explanation: AAP 2022: escalation tier когда TSB в narrow zone (около DVET threshold). Сначала intensive PT + IVIG. Exchange — если TSB не снижается за 6 ч или подъём ≥0.5 мг/дл/ч.

questions.q: Какая частота kernicterus у термин-новорождённого с TSB > 25 мг/дл (425 мкмоль/л)?
questions.explanation: По данным Pilot Kernicterus Registry — kernicterus риск при TSB >25 мг/дл редок (<5%) у healthy term, но резко возрастает при naglu hemolysis, sepsis, GA<38 нед, prematurity, hypoalbuminemia.

questions.q: Какой volume для DVET у term-newborn (double volume exchange)?
questions.explanation: Double volume exchange = 2 × blood volume. У term — blood volume 80 мл/кг → DVET 160 мл/кг. У preterm 90 мл/кг → DVET 180 мл/кг. Заменяет ~85% RBCs.

questions.q: При фототерапии — какая optimal длина волны?
questions.explanation: Билирубин максимально абсорбирует в синем спектре 460-490 нм. LED-PT с irradiance ≥30 мкВт/см²/нм — стандарт intensive PT.

questions.q: Какая main causa ГБН после Rh-D и ABO?
questions.explanation: Anti-Kell — третья по частоте причина ГБН (после Rh-D и ABO). Vyrazhennoe гемолиз + suppression эритропоэза — может требовать intrauterine transfusions.

questions.q: Какой возбудитель самый частый при EOS у term newborn?
questions.explanation: GBS — most common возбудитель EOS у term. У preterm — E. coli лидирует. Listeria всегда покрывается empiric ампициллином (хотя редкий).

questions.q: Empiric antibiotic regimen для EOS у term newborn?
questions.explanation: Ампициллин 50-100 мг/кг q8-12h IV + гентамицин 4-5 мг/кг q24h IV — стандарт EOS empiric coverage (GBS, E. coli, Listeria). При meningitis — добавить cefotaxime 50 мг/кг q8-12h.

questions.q: Empiric antibiotic regimen для LOS у newborn в NICU > 7 дней?
questions.explanation: LOS empiric: ванкомицин 10-15 мг/кг q8-12h (covers CoNS most common LOS, MRSA) + гентамицин или цефепим (Gram-negatives). При Candida риске + fluconazole 12 мг/кг q24h.

questions.q: В каком возрасте начинается LOS (late-onset sepsis)?
questions.explanation: EOS = ≤ 72 ч жизни (US definition); LOS = > 72 ч жизни до 90 дней. EOS обусловлен maternal flora; LOS — postnatal источники (CoNS catheter-related, S. aureus, Klebsiella, Candida).

questions.q: Какая стандартная empiric ABX для подозрения early-onset sepsis (<72 ч)?
questions.explanation: EOS empiric: ампициллин (50 мг/кг q8-12h) + гентамицин (4-5 мг/кг q24-48h по GA/age). Покрывает GBS, E. coli, Listeria — главные EOS pathogens.

questions.q: Какая duration ABX therapy для culture-negative но clinical sepsis?
questions.explanation: Culture-negative clinical sepsis ("presumed sepsis") — 5-7 дней. AAP CFN рекомендует прекращение через 36-48 ч если cultures negative и ребёнок clinically well.

questions.q: Какие main pathogens late-onset sepsis (>72 ч)?
options: Coagulase-negative staphylococci, S. aureus, Candida, gram-negative
questions.explanation: LOS = nosocomial: CoNS (40-50%), S. aureus, gram-negative (E.coli, Klebsiella, Pseudomonas), Candida (<5% but high mortality). Empiric: vanco + cefepime/gentamicin.

questions.q: При мать-positive GBS screening, intrapartum prophylaxis adekvatna при какой длительности?
questions.explanation: AAP: adekvatna IAP = пенициллин/ампициллин/цефазолин дан ≥4 ч до родов. Иначе well-appearing infant: observation 36-48 ч; ill-appearing: full work-up + ABX.

questions.q: Какой биомаркер sepsis у новорождённых superior к CRP в первые 6 ч?
questions.explanation: PCT поднимается за 4-6 ч (vs CRP за 12-24 ч). Reference в первые 24 ч жизни — physiologic peak. PCT >2 нг/мл после 24 ч — highly suggestive of bacterial sepsis.

questions.q: Какова reference frequency early-onset GBS sepsis в США в эру universal screening?
questions.explanation: После Universal screening + IAP частота снизилась с 1.7/1000 до ~0.2-0.25/1000 (CDC 2017). Но GBS остаётся #1 EOS pathogen с летальностью 5-10%.

questions.q: При culture-positive bacteremia — duration ABX?
questions.explanation: Bacteremia без meningitis: 10-14 дней. Meningitis: 14-21 день для GBS, 21 день для gram-negative. Endocarditis/osteomyelitis: 4-6 недель.

questions.q: Что такое blood culture "adequate volume" для diagnostic sensitivity у новорождённого?
questions.explanation: ≥1 мл blood culture — необходимо для adequate sensitivity (Schelonka 1996). <0.5 мл → false-negative до 60%. Использовать pediatric isolator/aerobic bottle.

questions.q: В каком окне времени должна начаться therapeutic hypothermia при HIE?
questions.explanation: TH должна начаться в первые ≤ 6 ч ("therapeutic window" — latent phase патогенеза). После 6 ч secondary energy failure уже established, эффективность снижается.

questions.q: Целевая температура core при whole-body cooling?
questions.explanation: Whole-body cooling целевая T core 33.5 ± 0.5 °C (esophageal или rectal probe). Selective head cooling 34.5-35 °C. Длительность 72 ч cooling + slow rewarming 0.5 °C/ч × 6-8 ч.

questions.q: Какие критерии включения для TH (Sarnat staging)?
questions.explanation: Критерии TH: GA ≥ 36 нед + BW ≥ 1800 г + возраст ≤ 6 ч + acidosis (pH < 7.0 или BE ≥ -16) + Sarnat moderate-severe (II-III) ИЛИ aEEG abnormal background. Mild HIE (Sarnat I) — не routine TH (controversial).

questions.q: Какой первый-line антиконвульсант при неонатальных судорогах?
questions.explanation: Phenobarbital 20 мг/кг IV slow loading — стандарт первой линии. Если seizures persist — repeat 10 мг/кг до cumulative 40 мг/кг. NeoLEV2 2020 — levetiracetam equivalent efficacy с лучшим safety profile (некоторые центры теперь используют как first-line).

questions.q: Какое окно для начала therapeutic hypothermia (TH)?
questions.explanation: TH должна начинаться в первые 6 ч от рождения (NICHD/TOBY). Эффективность снижается с задержкой. Раньше — лучше. После 6 ч — пользы доказательно нет.

questions.q: Какова target core temperature для cooling?
questions.explanation: Whole-body cooling (NICHD): 33-34°C × 72 ч. Selective head cooling: rectal 34-35°C × 72 ч. После 72 ч rewarming ≤0.5°C/ч.

questions.q: Какой первичный inclusion criterion для TH (NICHD)?
options: GA ≥ 36 нед, BW ≥ 1800 г, evidence of perinatal HIE, moderate/severe encephalopathy by Sarnat
questions.explanation: NICHD: GA ≥36 нед + BW ≥1800 г + perinatal HIE evidence (Apgar ≤5 на 10 мин ИЛИ ИВЛ ≥10 мин ИЛИ pH<7.0 ИЛИ BD≥16) + moderate/severe HIE по Sarnat.

questions.q: Какой anticonvulsant first-line при HIE seizures во время cooling?
questions.explanation: Фенобарбитал 20 мг/кг IV — first-line. При persistent seizures: повторить 10 мг/кг (до 40 мг/кг total). Затем леветирацетам или мидазолам.

questions.q: Какова target heart rate во время cooling?
questions.explanation: При cooling ЧСС обычно 70-100 уд/мин (sinus брадикардия из-за прохлаждения). Не лечить. Хорошо переносится. Hypotension и arrhythmia — redirect.

questions.q: Какой Hb target во время cooling?
questions.explanation: TH Hb target ≥13 г/дл (Hct ≥40%). Транзфузия PRBC при Hb<13 — улучшает cerebral O₂-delivery в условиях reduced metabolism + impaired autoregulation.

questions.q: Какой aEEG pattern у HIE highly predicts poor neurological outcome?
options: Burst suppression / flat trace в первые 24-36 ч despite TH
questions.explanation: Burst suppression / flat trace persistent через 36 ч TH — poor predictor (>80% adverse outcome). Sleep-wake cycles return до 36 ч — good prognostic sign.

questions.q: Какой metabolic abnormality характерна для HIE rewarming phase?
questions.explanation: Rewarming: K+ shifts (re-equilibration), hypoglycemia (anaerobic glycolysis после), hypotension (vasodilation). Поддерживай glucose, monitor K+, slow rewarming ≤0.5°C/ч.

questions.q: Когда начинать parenteral aminoacids у preterm < 32 нед?
questions.explanation: ESPGHAN 2018 — aminoacids 1.5-2 г/кг/d стартовать в первые ≤ 2 ч жизни. Цель: быстро вывести из negative nitrogen balance. Goal 3-4 г/кг/d (extreme preterm 4-4.5 г/кг/d).

questions.q: Каков target GIR (glucose infusion rate) у newborn на TPN?
questions.explanation: Старт GIR 4-6 мг/кг/мин (term) или 6-8 мг/кг/мин (preterm, для glucose tolerance). Advance 1-2 мг/кг/мин q24h. Tolerance limit 12-13 мг/кг/мин (выше — hyperglycemia, lipogenesis).

questions.q: Какой preferred lipid emulsion в PN у preterm?
questions.explanation: SMOFlipid (soybean + medium chain + olive + fish oil) — preferred 2024. Less pro-inflammatory + ↓ PNALD risk vs pure soy. Goal 3-4 г/кг/d (max 4).

questions.q: Trophic feeds у extreme preterm — это:
options: Минимальные enteral feeds 10-20 мл/кг/d первые 5-7 дней
questions.explanation: Trophic feeds 10-20 мл/кг/d минимальные первые 5-7 дней — стимулируют развитие кишечника, снижают холестаз TPN-related, снижают NEC risk. Затем advancement 15-20 мл/кг/день.

questions.q: Стартовая доза aminoacids в TPN у preterm в день 1 жизни?
questions.explanation: ESPGHAN 2018: aminoacids 1.5-3.0 г/кг/сут с day 1 (early aggressive). Цель 3.5-4 г/кг/сут к day 2-3. "Metabolic preconditioning" подход.

questions.q: Lipid emulsion of choice for preterm TPN?
options: SMOFlipid (mixed: soy, MCT, olive, fish oil)
questions.explanation: SMOFlipid (mixed) — ESPGHAN 2018 preferred. Snizhayet IFALD risk vs pure soy. Старт 1-2 г/кг/сут, целевая 3-4 г/кг/сут. У preterm c IFALD — rybnyi жир.

questions.q: Какова target GIR для term-newborn в первые сутки?
questions.explanation: Target GIR 5-8 мг/кг/мин у term для maintenance euglycemia. Preterm — 4-12 мг/кг/мин (выше при гипогликемии). Max GIR 12-14 — риск hyperglycemia.

questions.q: Какой trophic feed volume у VLBW для maturation gut?
questions.explanation: Trophic feeds 10-25 мл/кг/сут × 3-5 дней — "gut priming" без caloric intent. Снижает NEC, accelerates full feeds, improves gut motility (ESPGHAN 2022 EN).

questions.q: При weight loss > какого % от birth weight у term breastfed newborn red flag?
questions.explanation: AAP: weight loss >7% — evaluate breastfeeding effectiveness. >10% — lactation consultant + supplement. >12% — medical evaluation (dehydration, hypernatremia).

questions.q: Какой Vitamin K dose для prevention VKDB?
options: 1 мг IM (BW>1000 г), 0.5 мг IM (BW<1000 г)
questions.explanation: AAP/Cochrane: 1 мг IM × 1 dose (term/preterm BW>1000 г), 0.5 мг IM (BW<1000 г). Sole IM — prevent late VKDB. PO — повторные дозы required, less effective.

questions.q: Когда начинать HMF (Human Milk Fortifier) у VLBW?
questions.explanation: ESPGHAN 2022: HMF при достижении EN 80-100 мл/кг/сут. Preterm milk не покрывает потребности GA<32 нед / BW<1800 г. Стандартное обогащение 4 г/100 мл.

questions.q: Какова daily fluid requirement для term-newborn day 1 vs day 7?
questions.explanation: Term day 1: 60-80 мл/кг (insensible loss limited). Прогрессирует +20 мл/кг/сут. Day 7: 150-160 мл/кг maintenance. ELBW начинают выше из-за ↑insensible loss.

questions.q: Какой первый шаг при подозрении на IEM с гипераммониемией?
options: NPO + D10W IV at GIR 8-10 мг/кг/мин
questions.explanation: NPO (стоп protein) + D10W IV at GIR 8-10 мг/кг/мин — провести adequate energy для остановки endogenous protein catabolism. Затем: empiric IEM cocktail + Ammonul, при NH3 > 500 — emergent dialysis.

questions.q: Какой компонент IEM-cocktail для метилмалоновой ацидемии?
questions.explanation: MMA: hydroxocobalamin (B12) 1 мг IM daily — некоторые формы cobalamin-responsive. Также: L-carnitine 100-300 мг/кг/d (secondary deficiency), low-protein diet, при гипераммониемии — Ammonul.

questions.q: Какая доза Ammonul (Na phenylacetate + benzoate) при острой гипераммониемии?
questions.explanation: Ammonul loading 250 мг/кг IV over 90-120 мин (mixed phenylacetate + benzoate). Затем maintenance 250-500 мг/кг/d split q6-8h IV. Bypasses urea cycle через alternative nitrogen excretion (hippurate, phenylacetylglutamine).

questions.q: Какая первая мера при подозрении на IEM с hyperammonemia (NH3 > 200 ммоль/л)?
options: STOP protein, start D10 IV (GIR 8-10), call metabolic team, dialysis prep при NH3>500
questions.explanation: Hyperammonemia rescue: ⚫️ stop protein (transient catabolism!) ⚫️ D10 GIR 8-10 mg/kg/min (anabolic switch) ⚫️ sodium benzoate/phenylacetate ⚫️ L-arginine (UCD) ⚫️ dialysis при NH3>500 ммоль/л.

questions.q: При urea cycle defect (UCD), какой ammonium scavenger first-line?
options: Sodium benzoate + sodium phenylacetate (Ammonul) IV bolus + infusion
questions.explanation: Ammonul = Na-benzoate (250 мг/кг) + Na-phenylacetate (250 мг/кг) — alternative ammonia removal. Также L-arginine 200-600 мг/кг. Glycerol phenylbutyrate — chronic.

questions.q: Какой IEM B12-responsive (cyanocobalamin) presents с hyperammonemia + acidemia?
questions.explanation: CblA/CblB MMA — B12-responsive forms. Trial OH-cobalamin 1 мг IM 3-5 дней. CblC — also B12-responsive (MMA + homocystinuria).

questions.q: При galactosemia первая мера?
questions.explanation: Classical galactosemia (GALT-deficiency) — immediately switch to soy/elemental lactose-free formula. Грудное молоко содержит lactose=galactose — contraindicated.

questions.q: Какой biomarker подозрения на organic acidemia?
options: Anion gap metabolic acidosis + ketosis + hyperammonemia + lactic acidosis
questions.explanation: OA classic triad: HAGMA + ketosis + hyperammonemia (но может быть mild). Plus lactic acidosis, hypoglycemia. Workup: urine organic acids, plasma acylcarnitines, ammonia.

questions.q: Какой IEM screened by NBS as elevated C5-DC acylcarnitine?
questions.explanation: GA-1 — elevated glutarylcarnitine (C5-DC) на NBS. Не лечить → macrocephaly + striatal injury → dystonic CP. Lysine/tryptophan-restricted diet + carnitine.

questions.q: При MCAD (medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency) — main risk?
questions.explanation: MCAD: impaired fatty acid oxidation → hypoketotic hypoglycemia при fasting/illness. Sudden death possible. Treatment: avoid fasting >6-8 ч, IV glucose при illness, carnitine PRN.

questions.q: Какой IEM с burnt-sugar / maple syrup smell мочи?
questions.explanation: MSUD — BCAA (leucine, isoleucine, valine) accumulate. Ketotic breath/urine → maple syrup. Severe encephalopathy при leucine>1500 µmol/L. Treatment: BCAA-restricted diet, dialysis severe.

questions.q: При phenylketonuria (PKU) screening cut-off?
questions.explanation: PKU treatment threshold Phe ≥1000 µmol/L (классический PKU). Mild HPA 360-600 — monitoring; classical >1200 — strict diet. NBS positive screen ≥2-3 SD above population mean.

questions.q: Когда оптимально брать первый sample для metabolic screening?
questions.explanation: Term: 24-72 ч жизни (после first feed для PKU sensitivity). Preterm — initial 24-72 ч + повторный в 36 нед PMA. NICU + TPN: при entry + repeat если long-term TPN. Перед transfusion обязательно.

questions.q: CCHD pulse oximetry screening — где ставится probe?
questions.explanation: CCHD screen: правая рука (pre-ductal) + либо нога (post-ductal) одновременно. Pass: SpO₂ ≥ 95 % обеих сторон AND difference < 3 %. Fail: < 90 %; persistent < 95 % после 3 measurements + 1 ч; ≥ 3 % difference.

questions.q: Когда начинается ROP screening у preterm GA 27-30 нед?
options: В 4 нед PNA или 31 нед PMA — позднее из двух
questions.explanation: ROP screen первый осмотр: GA 22-26 нед — 31 нед PMA; GA 27-30 нед — 4 нед PNA или 31 нед PMA — whichever later; GA 31-32 нед — 4 нед PNA. Late preterm с unstable course — clinical judgment.

questions.q: Optimal sample timing для NBS dried blood spot?
questions.explanation: Optimal NBS — 24-48 ч жизни. <24 ч — многие IEM screens не обнаружат. До PRBC transfusion (false-negative). Repeat если <24 ч или transfused.

questions.q: При CCHD pulse oximetry screening — failed criteria?
options: SpO₂ <90% любой site OR ≥3% разница right-hand vs foot × 3 measurements 1 hr apart OR <95% обе site
questions.explanation: AAP-CCHD: pulse ox 24-48 h. Fail: SpO₂<90% любой site, OR <95% obe site × 3 × 1 hr, OR ≥3% разница RH vs foot × 3. Sensitivity ~76% для critical CHD.

questions.q: Когда проводить CCHD screening?
questions.explanation: CCHD pulse ox screening после 24 ч жизни (24-48 ч optimal). До 24 ч — transitional circulation → false-positives (1.6% vs 0.4% после 24 ч).

questions.q: Когда первый ROP screen у preterm GA ≤ 30 нед?
options: 31-34 нед PMA OR 4-6 недель chronologic age (whichever later)
questions.explanation: AAP/AAO 2018: GA<27 нед — 31 нед PMA. GA 27-30 нед — 31-32 нед PMA OR 4 недель chronologic. Examined каждые 1-3 нед до зрелости retina.

questions.q: Какой first-tier hearing screen у newborn?
options: AABR (Automated Auditory Brainstem Response) или OAE (OtoAcoustic Emissions)
questions.explanation: AABR > OAE для NICU babies (catches retrocochlear). AABR fail → follow-up до 3 мес. Diagnostic ABR + intervention до 6 мес. AAP "1-3-6 rule".

questions.q: При positive NBS на CF (cystic fibrosis) confirmed by?
questions.explanation: CF NBS: IRT (immunoreactive trypsinogen) elevated → CFTR genotyping. Confirmed: sweat chloride >60 ммоль/л OR 2 disease-causing CFTR mutations. >40 ммоль/л — borderline, repeat.

questions.q: Когда проводить screening для CHD при семейной истории?
options: Пренатально (fetal echo) при семейном CHD у first-degree relative
questions.explanation: Fetal echo 18-22 нед при семейном CHD у first-degree relative (риск 3-7%), maternal diabetes pre-gestational, maternal CHD, abnormal NT, IVF, abnormal screening.

questions.q: Какие 36 заболеваний включены в NBS РФ с 01.01.2023?
questions.explanation: NBS РФ с 2023 — expanded: 5 классических (PKU, ВГ, ВДКН, MCAD, AGT), плюс СМА, первичные иммунодефициты, и tandem MS — 29 IEM. Total 36.

questions.q: При congenital hypothyroidism (CH) NBS positive — confirmation?
questions.explanation: CH confirm: serum TSH + free T4. Если TSH>40 mIU/L OR fT4 low — start L-thyroxine 10-15 mcg/kg/d immediately. Goal TSH<5 mIU/L by 2 нед, fT4 normal по 1 мес.

questions.q: Какое начальное лечение PPHN после оптимизации gas exchange?
questions.explanation: iNO 20 ppm — first-line при PPHN после оптимизации ventilation/oxygenation/sedation. Wean к 5 ppm, затем off при FiO₂ < 50 %. Sildenafil/milrinone — adjunct/escalation. ECMO — rescue при OI > 40.

questions.q: Critria для ECMO у PPHN-инфанта:
options: OI > 40 sustained 4 ч despite optimal therapy
questions.explanation: OI > 40 sustained 4 ч despite iNO + medical therapy — стандартный ECMO threshold (ELSO 2023). GA ≥ 34 нед, BW ≥ 2 кг, reversible disease, без contraindications (severe IVH, lethal anomaly).

questions.q: Какой preferred vasopressor для catecholamine-refractory warm shock у PPHN?
questions.explanation: Vasopressin 0.0001-0.001 ед/кг/мин — preferred при catecholamine-refractory warm shock (low SVR). Mechanism: V1 vasoconstriction. Choong NEJM 2009; SSC Pediatric 2020.

questions.q: PPHN screening: какая SpO₂ difference указывает на R-to-L shunt?
questions.explanation: Pre-ductal SpO₂ (right hand) > Post-ductal (foot) by ≥ 5-10 % = R-to-L shunt через PDA. Это hallmark PPHN или ductal-dependent CHD. Reverse differential (post > pre) специфично для TGA + restrictive PFO.

questions.q: Какая стартовая доза iNO для PPHN?
questions.explanation: iNO стартовая 20 ppm. Если responder (↑SpO₂, ↑PaO₂, ↓OI), wean over 24-48 ч. Не превышать 40 ppm (risk metHb). Wean by 5 ppm каждые 4 ч до 5 ppm, then taper to 1 ppm.

questions.q: Когда рассматривать ECMO при PPHN?
options: OI > 25-40 несмотря на full medical (iNO, sildenafil, milrinone, optimized vent)
questions.explanation: ECMO criteria PPHN: OI ≥25-40 (varies by center) AFTER optimized therapy (iNO, sildenafil, milrinone, surfactant если RDS, optimal MAP). GA ≥34 нед, BW ≥2 кг typically.

questions.q: Какова доза sildenafil для PPHN (oral/NG)?
questions.explanation: Sildenafil 0.5-2 мг/кг q6h PO/NG. IV рекомендуется в emergency (но reserved). Adjuvant к iNO. Cochrane: improves oxygenation в LMICs где iNO unavailable.

questions.q: При warm shock у newborn (vasodilated, low SVR) — vasopressor of choice?
questions.explanation: Warm shock = vasodilated, high CO, low SVR. Vasopressin selective V1-receptor — raises SVR без ↑PVR (ideal в PPHN). Стартовая 0.0003-0.0005 U/kg/min.

questions.q: Какая SpO₂ differential confirms RIGHT-to-LEFT shunting через PFO/PDA?
questions.explanation: PPHN: pre-ductal (RH) > post-ductal (foot). Differential >5-10% → R-to-L shunting через PDA. “Reverse differential” (foot>RH) → transposition (TGA) с PPHN.

questions.q: При hyperoxia test (100% O₂ × 10 мин) failed (PaO₂<150) предполагает?
questions.explanation: Failed hyperoxia (PaO₂<150 на 100%FiO₂) suggests R-to-L shunting от cyanotic CHD (TGA, TOF, etc) или severe PPHN. Confirms via echo + cardiac eval.

questions.q: Milrinone в PPHN — как inotrope/inodilator работает?
options: PDE-3 ингибитор: inotrope + systemic + PVR vasodilation
questions.explanation: Milrinone PDE-3 inhibitor → ↑cAMP → inotropy + vasodilation (systemic + pulmonary). Доза 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин (no loading в neonates). Adjuvant в PPHN с RV dysfunction.

questions.q: Какая main side effect iNO?
options: Methemoglobinemia (>5%) + NO₂ toxicity, rebound PHTN при abrupt withdrawal
questions.explanation: iNO toxicity: metHb (monitor q12h, особенно >40 ppm), NO₂ (irritant, monitor in ventilator circuit). Rebound PHTN — wean slowly! Не abrupt discontinuation.

questions.q: Какой R-graphic finding pathognomonic для NEC?
questions.explanation: Pneumatosis intestinalis (foamy gas в стенке кишки) — pathognomonic для NEC, видна в 50 % cases на R-graph. Portal venous gas — менее частый но severe sign. Free air (Rigler's sign) — surgical perforation.

questions.q: Empiric ABX для NEC IIB+:
questions.explanation: NEC IIB+ — triple-therapy: ампициллин 50-100 мг/кг q8h + гентамицин 4-5 мг/кг q24h + метронидазол 7.5 мг/кг q8-24h (anaerobic coverage). При CONS/MRSA risk — vancomycin вместо ампициллина.

questions.q: При каком Bell stage показана хирургия?
questions.explanation: Bell IIIB (perforation, free air, peritonitis) — absolute indication к laparotomy + resection + enterostomy. ELBW < 1000 g unstable — peritoneal drainage (Moss NEJM 2006) как stabilization.

questions.q: Какая мера снижает NEC у preterm < 1500 g?
questions.explanation: Mother's own milk ↓ NEC ~50 % vs formula (Quigley Cochrane 2019; Patel JAMA 2016 dose-response). Donor milk — second-best. Probiotics — controversial (AAP 2021 не routine). Trophic feeds + slow advancement дополнительно protective.

questions.q: Какая Bell stage III диагностические критерии?
options: Стадия IIIA: severe NEC + perforation pending; IIIB: confirmed pneumoperitoneum/perforation
questions.explanation: Bell IIIA: severe NEC, hypotension, DIC, persistent acidosis, but no perforation; IIIB: confirmed pneumoperitoneum on AXR → surgical NEC. Mortality 30-50%.

questions.q: Triple-ABX для медицинского NEC management?
questions.explanation: Suspected NEC: Amp + gent + metro (anaerobe coverage) × 7-14 дней. Severe/perforated: meropenem ± vanco. Adjust based on culture. Source control — surgical если perforated.

questions.q: Какова first-line surgical option при NEC IIIB у preterm <1000 г?
questions.explanation: NECSTEPS trial: PPD vs laparotomy у ELBW — no mortality difference. PPD сначала, laparotomy если no improvement. У larger preterm — laparotomy preferred.

questions.q: Главный risk factor для NEC у preterm?
options: Preterm birth + formula feeding + intestinal dysbiosis
questions.explanation: NEC pathogenesis: prematurity (immature gut barrier) + formula (vs breastmilk → no bifidobacteria) + dysbiosis + ischemia. Breastmilk reduces NEC by 6-10x в VLBW.

questions.q: Pneumatosis intestinalis на AXR — патогномоничная для NEC?
options: Highly suggestive (Bell IIA+) но также at hyperinflation, post-cardiac surgery, infection
questions.explanation: Pneumatosis intestinalis — highly suggestive of NEC (Bell IIA+). Но возможна post-cardiac surgery, severe enteritis. Combined с clinical context (feeding intolerance, abdominal distension, hematochezia).

questions.q: При NEC — typical timing?
options: 10-14 дней postnatal у preterm после full-volume feeds
questions.explanation: NEC peak incidence — 2-3 неделя postnatal у preterm после establishment full-volume feeds. У term unusual — ассоциирован c congenital heart disease, polycythemia, perinatal asphyxia.

questions.q: Какой biomarker emerging для NEC diagnosis?
questions.explanation: I-FABP — sensitive marker enterocyte injury. Combined с urinary I-FABP, claudin-3, fecal calprotectin — emerging diagnostic panel. Не replaces clinical suspicion.

questions.q: После medical NEC — когда возобновлять кормление?
options: После 7-10 дней NPO + bowel rest, slow advance
questions.explanation: После medical NEC: NPO + ABX 7-14 дней. Resume trophic feeds после bowel rest, normal AXR, clinical stability. Slow advance 10-20 мл/кг/сут. Breastmilk preferred.

questions.q: ECHO критерий hemodynamically-significant PDA (HSPDA):
options: Diameter ≥ 1.5 мм + LA:Ao > 1.5 + reverse diastolic flow
questions.explanation: HSPDA criteria: diameter ≥ 1.5 мм (или > 1.4 мм/кг) + LA:Ao > 1.5 + reverse/absent diastolic flow в descending aorta + LV dilation. Шум — clinical sign, но ECHO definitive.

questions.q: Доза ibuprofen lysine для closure PDA:
questions.explanation: Ibuprofen lysine: 10 мг/кг loading IV → 5 мг/кг q24h × 2 doses. Closure rate 70-80 %. Indomethacin alternative — 0.2 мг/кг loading → 0.1-0.2 мг/кг q12h × 2 (но больше renal toxicity). Paracetamol 15 мг/кг q6h × 3-7 d — newer alternative.

questions.q: Какой препарат для PDA closure имеет наилучший renal/GI safety profile?
questions.explanation: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) IV — лучший safety profile (Cochrane 2020 Ohlsson). Equivalent ibuprofen efficacy. Hammerman 2011 first reports. Reserve indomethacin для специальных indications (severe IVH prevention).

questions.q: Какие ECHO criteria для hemodynamically significant PDA (hsPDA)?
options: PDA ≥1.5 мм + LA:Ao ≥1.4 + LV diastolic dysfunction OR retrograde diastolic flow в descending aorta
questions.explanation: hsPDA criteria: ductal size ≥1.5 мм, LA:Ao ratio ≥1.4, LV волемический overload, retrograde diastolic flow в descending aorta или mesenteric/cerebral arteries.

questions.q: Какая stardartnaya doza ibuprofen для PDA closure?
questions.explanation: Ibuprofen IV: 10 мг/кг → 5 мг/кг через 24 ч → 5 мг/кг через 24 ч (1 cycle). Closure rate ~70-80%. Препарат выбора preterm (vs indomethacin — less side effects).

questions.q: Paracetamol (acetaminophen) для PDA closure — доза?
questions.explanation: Paracetamol (Hammerman 2011) 15 мг/кг q6h × 3 дня. Closure rate ~70%. Alternative когда NSAIDs contraindicated (renal impairment, thrombocytopenia, NEC, IVH).

questions.q: Indomethacin доза для PDA?
questions.explanation: Indomethacin: первая доза 0.2 мг/кг IV → затем 0.1 мг/кг q12-24h (по age) × 2. Closure ~70%. More renal / GI side effects vs ibuprofen.

questions.q: При неэффективности 2 cycles medical closure — surgical ligation у каких preterm?
options: Persistent hsPDA с failure to wean ventilator/CPAP, weight gain failure, или volume overload
questions.explanation: Surgical PDA ligation reserved для: failed 2 medical cycles, persistent hsPDA с inability to wean respiratory support, congestive heart failure. Trial conservative management впервые.

questions.q: При conservative PDA management — fluid restriction цель?
questions.explanation: Fluid restriction 120-130 мл/кг/сут (vs unrestricted 150-160) при hsPDA — снижает LV preload + risk pulmonary edema. Diuretics (furosemide 1 мг/кг q12-24h) PRN.

questions.q: Какова probability of spontaneous PDA closure у preterm к 1 неделе life?
options: 30-50% у всех preterm — zavisит от GA, BW
questions.explanation: У preterm spontaneous closure rate: GA<28 нед — ~30-40% к 1 неделе; GA 28-32 нед — 50-70%; GA>32 нед — 80-90%. Selective treatment vs prophylactic — current trend.

questions.q: Indomethacin contraindications у preterm?
options: Active bleeding, severe thrombocytopenia (<50k), oliguria/AKI, NEC, IVH grade III-IV
questions.explanation: NSAIDs (indomethacin/ibuprofen) contraindications: active bleeding, plt<50k, oliguria <0.6 мл/кг/ч, Cr>1.6, suspected/confirmed NEC, IVH III-IV. Paracetamol — alternative.

questions.q: Когда первый ECHO assessment PDA у preterm <30 нед?
options: День 3-7 (после initial transition) если clinical concern
questions.explanation: Functional ECHO для hsPDA assessment after transition (day 3-7), если signs (murmur, bounding pulses, widened pulse pressure, failure to wean). Не routine у asymptomatic.

questions.q: Скорость rewarming после 72 ч cooling:
questions.explanation: Slow rewarming 0.5 °C / ч × 6-8 ч — критично! Быстрое rewarming → seizures, intracranial bleeding, electrolyte shifts. Sedation continues during rewarming. После 80 ч — wean sedation gradually.

questions.q: Какой anticonvulsant начинают при HIE seizures?
questions.explanation: Phenobarbital 20 мг/кг IV slow loading — стандарт первой линии при HIE seizures. NeoLEV2 2020 — levetiracetam 40-60 мг/кг IV equivalent efficacy с лучшим safety profile (некоторые center now use as first-line).

questions.q: Целевая Hb во время cooling у HIE-инфанта:
questions.explanation: Hb 120-150 г/л оптимально для O₂ delivery в poor-perfusion settings + cooling. Transfuse при Hb < 100 g/l если symptomatic. Avoid extreme polycythemia (> 200) — viscosity ухудшает microcirculation.

questions.q: Rewarming rate после 72 ч cooling?
questions.explanation: Rewarming ≤0.5°C/ч (passive). Rapid rewarming → ↑cerebral metabolism + risk seizures, hypotension, hyperthermia rebound. Целевая 36.5°C reached over 8-12 ч.

questions.q: Какие main contraindications TH?
options: Major chromosomal/lethal anomalies, intractable bleeding, head trauma, weight <1.8 kg, GA<36 нед
questions.explanation: TH absolute contraindications: lethal anomalies/major congenital, intractable bleeding, severe head trauma, weight <1800 g, GA<36 нед. Relative: severe IVH, sepsis (controversial).

questions.q: Какие seizures markers во время cooling — EEG monitoring?
options: Continuous aEEG/EEG — monitoring 72 ч во время cooling + during rewarming
questions.explanation: TH protocol: continuous aEEG/EEG × 72 ч (electrographic seizures у 30-50% HIE). Subclinical seizures common. Treat persistent seizures → phenobarbital.

questions.q: Какова mortality reduction TH в moderate/severe HIE (NICHD/TOBY meta-analysis)?
questions.explanation: Cochrane meta-analysis: TH снижает death/major neurodevelopmental disability на 18 мес. NNT ≈ 9 (один "saved" на каждые 9 cooled). NNT 8 для death only.

questions.q: При BG (blood glucose) во время cooling — target?
options: Avoid hypo (<50) AND hyperglycemia (>150) — glucose 4-7 ммоль/л optimal
questions.explanation: TH glucose: avoid hypoglycemia (<2.6 ммоль/л) AND hyperglycemia (>8 ммоль/л). Both worsen outcomes. Target 4-7 ммоль/л. Insulin при persistent >10 ммоль/л.

questions.q: При HIE с persistent acidosis после TH start — first action?
options: Optimize ventilation/perfusion (correct hypoxia, hypotension, sepsis), avoid bicarb routinely
questions.explanation: Acidosis в HIE — metabolic + respiratory. Treat root cause: ventilation, perfusion, sepsis. Bicarbonate routinely NOT recommended (paradoxical CSF acidosis). Reserved для severe pH<7.0 + adequate ventilation.

questions.q: Какая optimal MAP у HIE-cooled newborn?
options: MAP 40-50 (40 minimum) для adequate cerebral perfusion
questions.explanation: TH MAP target ≥40 мм рт. ст. для adequate cerebral perfusion в setting impaired autoregulation. Hypotension → dopamine 5-10 мкг/кг/мин ИЛИ dobutamine if cardiac dysfunction.

questions.q: Какие investigations после TH для outcome prediction?
options: MRI brain @ day 4-7, EEG, neuro exam (Sarnat), aEEG patterns
questions.explanation: Post-cooling assessment: MRI day 4-7 (DWI for ischemic injury), continuous aEEG, formal neurological exam (Sarnat). MRI scoring — PVL, BG/thalamic injury — strong predictors.

questions.q: Какие adjunctive therapies добавляют к TH в HIE?
options: Erythropoietin (EPO), melatonin, allopurinol, xenon — research/limited clinical use
questions.explanation: Adjunctive therapies в research/trial: EPO 1000 U/kg q48h (НЕОНАЛ trial — mixed results), melatonin (antioxidant), allopurinol, xenon (NDA). Not yet standard care.

questions.q: Kaiser EOS calculator применим для:
questions.explanation: Kaiser EOS Calculator (Pediatrics 2024;154:e2023065267) — для GA ≥ 35 нед. Учитывает clinical condition + maternal risk factors + GBS status. Для preterm < 35 нед — Puopolo Tiered approach (AAP 2018).

questions.q: Risk factors EOS materinski:
options: GBS culture+, fever ≥ 38 °C, ROM ≥ 18 ч, GA < 37 нед, chorio, inadequate IAP
questions.explanation: Maternal EOS risk factors: GBS+ (или unknown), maternal fever ≥ 38 °C intrapartum, ROM ≥ 18 ч до родов (PROM), GA < 37 нед, chorioamnionitis, inadequate intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP). Все учитываются в Kaiser calculator.

questions.q: Длительность ABX курса при EOS culture-positive bacteremia (без meningitis):
questions.explanation: Bacteremia EOS без meningitis — 7-10 дней. Stop ABX при negative cultures × 36-48 ч у low-risk. Meningitis — 14-21 day. GBS meningitis — 14 d; Gram-negative meningitis — 21 d. Switch к narrow-spectrum по sensitivity результатам.

questions.q: Kaiser EOS calculator inputs?
options: GA, max maternal temp, ROM duration, GBS status, intrapartum ABX
questions.explanation: Kaiser EOS calc inputs: gestational age, highest maternal temp intrapartum, duration ROM, GBS colonisation status, intrapartum ABX (type + duration). Output: EOS risk + management recommendation.

questions.q: Puopolo Tiered approach используется для?
options: Preterm GA<34 нед — категоризирует maternal risk + neonatal status
questions.explanation: Puopolo (Pediatrics 2017) Tiered approach у preterm <34 нед: high vs lower risk categories по maternal infectious risk factors (chorioamnionitis, GBS, fever) + neonatal clinical condition.

questions.q: При Kaiser EOS calc — risk ≥3/1000 что recommends?
questions.explanation: Kaiser EOS recommendation: <1/1000 routine care; 1-3/1000 enhanced observation/blood culture; ≥3/1000 empiric ABX + blood culture. Cumulative neonatal status (well/equivocal/clinical illness) modifies.

questions.q: При adequate intrapartum prophylaxis (IAP) у GBS-pos матери — что для well-appearing newborn?
questions.explanation: Adequate IAP (PCN/амп/цефазолин ≥4 ч до родов) + well-appearing infant — routine care, no labs/ABX. Vital sign monitoring per protocol. Adequate IAP снижает EOS GBS на 80%.

questions.q: Какой duration empiric ABX при negative cultures + clinical sepsis-like presentation?
options: 36-48 ч и stop если cultures negative + clinical improvement
questions.explanation: If cultures negative + clinical improvement — stop empiric ABX 36-48 ч. Continued ABX exposure increases candidiasis, antibiotic resistance, dysbiosis (NEC risk у preterm).

questions.q: При chorioamnionitis maternal — newborn management?
options: Increase EOS suspicion: full work-up + empiric ABX в зависимости от newborn presentation + Kaiser/Puopolo
questions.explanation: Maternal chorioamnionitis — EOS risk fact. Newborn approach: clinical status + Kaiser EOS calc. Если clinical signs — full work-up + empiric ABX. Otherwise enhanced observation — 36-48 ч.

questions.q: Какой empiric ABX у preterm <34 нед при подозрении EOS?
questions.explanation: Standard EOS у preterm: ампициллин + гентамицин (covers GBS, E.coli, Listeria — main EOS pathogens). Cefotaxime substitute если concern для CSF (ампи+гент vs amp+cefotaxime у meningitis).

questions.q: Какова mortality early-onset sepsis у preterm <34 нед?
questions.explanation: EOS preterm mortality 10-20% (vs term ~3%). Higher у GA<28 нед. GBS specifically — 5-10% term, 15-25% preterm. Meningitis worse outcome.

questions.q: При GBS-positive screening + ROM>18 ч + maternal fever + inadequate IAP — management?
options: Full work-up: blood culture + CBC + CRP + empiric amp+gent (cover meningitis if signs)
questions.explanation: Multi-factorial high risk EOS: full lab work-up + empiric ABX (amp+gent or amp+cefotaxime if meningitis concern). LP if symptomatic OR positive blood culture. Cover ≥48 ч pending cultures.

questions.q: Когда начинать trophic feeds у VLBW < 1500 g?
options: Только после полного перехода с TPN
questions.explanation: Trophic feeds (10-20 мл/кг/d) — начинать после первой стабилизации (24-48 ч), даже на TPN. Цель: stimulation gut + ↓ cholestasis + ↓ NEC + ↑ adaptive bowel growth. ESPGHAN 2022 supports early trophic for VLBW.

questions.q: Темп advancement enteral feeds у VLBW после 5-7 days trophic:
questions.explanation: Advancement 15-20 мл/кг/d — стандарт для VLBW (ESPGHAN 2022). Быстрее (≥ 30 мл/кг/d) — controversial, может ↑ NEC у некоторых studies; slower than 15 — задерживает full enteral nutrition. Stop при apnea, residuals, distension.

questions.q: Когда добавлять human milk fortifier (HMF)?
questions.explanation: HMF добавляется при 80-100 мл/кг/d enteral — обеспечивает adequate protein/Ca/P для bone mineralization. Стандарт 22-24 ккал/oz fortification. Без HMF preterm milk не покрывает potential growth needs у VLBW.

questions.q: Optimal first feed для VLBW preterm?
options: Mom's own milk (preferred) > donor breast milk > preterm formula — trophic 10-20 мл/кг/сут
questions.explanation: VLBW first feed: own mother's milk preferred (immunologic, NEC reduction, neurodevelopmental). Donor milk если MOM unavailable. Formula — last resort. Start trophic 10-20 мл/кг/сут from day 1-2.

questions.q: Advancement rate у stable VLBW (BW 1000-1500 г)?
questions.explanation: VLBW stable: advance 20-30 мл/кг/сут после trophic phase. ELBW (<1000 г): 10-20 мл/кг/сут (slower). Reach full feeds 150-180 мл/кг/сут к day 7-14.

questions.q: Когда добавить HMF (Human Milk Fortifier) в milk?
questions.explanation: HMF при volume ≥80-100 мл/кг/сут. Standard fortification 4 г/100 мл (24 ккал/унц.). Targeted/adjustable fortification (по urea, growth) — individualized.

questions.q: Какова caloric target для VLBW growing preterm?
questions.explanation: ESPGHAN 2022: 110-130 ккал/кг/сут для adequate growth. Protein 3.5-4.5 г/кг/сут. Mix MOM + HMF — standard. Monitor weight, length, head circumference.

questions.q: Какова IUGR/SGA preterm advancement strategy?
options: Slow advancement (cautious): risk NEC + feeding intolerance higher
questions.explanation: SGA с absent/reversed end-diastolic flow — higher NEC risk. Cautious advancement 15-20 мл/кг/сут. SIFT trial: faster advancement (30 мл/кг/сут) — no ↑ NEC у stable preterm.

questions.q: При gastric residuals у preterm — when concern?
options: Bilious, blood-stained, OR >50% of prior feed in clinical context — investigate. Routine measurement не recommended.
questions.explanation: Routine gastric residual measurement NOT recommended (Cochrane). “Concerning” residuals: bilious, hemorrhagic, OR very large in setting other signs (distention, lethargy, hemodynamic instability).

questions.q: При full feeds attained — when stop TPN?
options: When EN ≥ 120-140 мл/кг/сут с adequate caloric/protein delivery
questions.explanation: Stop TPN at full EN ≥ 120-140 мл/кг/сут с adequate caloric (>110 ккал/кг/сут) + protein (>3 г/кг/сут) intake. Wean lipids first, then aminoacids, then glucose. Maintain CVL до 48 ч после wean.

questions.q: При formula intolerance у preterm — first-line alternative?
options: Hydrolysed protein formula (semi-elemental) ИЛИ donor milk
questions.explanation: Formula intolerance: try (1) donor breast milk если available; (2) extensively hydrolysed (Pregestimil, Nutramigen) или amino acid-based (Neocate); (3) avoid soy/goat у preterm.

questions.q: Какой optimal time для starting probiotic у VLBW (для NEC prevention)?
options: Trial показывают benefit при start с trophic feeds (Lactobacillus + Bifidobacterium combo)
questions.explanation: ProPrems trial + Cochrane meta-analysis: probiotics (combo Lactobacillus + Bifidobacterium) с start trophic feeds снижает NEC, mortality, sepsis у VLBW. Не universally adopted (manufacturing variability).

questions.q: Когда первый ROP screen у GA 28 нед?
options: В 4 нед PNA или 31 нед PMA — позднее из двух
questions.explanation: GA 27-30 нед: первый exam в 4 нед PNA или 31 нед PMA — whichever later. У GA 28 нед = 4 нед PNA = 32 нед PMA → 32 PMA (больше). GA 22-26 нед: с 31 PMA. GA 31-32 нед: с 4 нед PNA.

questions.q: Type 1 ROP — preferred treatment 2024:
questions.explanation: Anti-VEGF preferred 2024 для Zone I ROP: ranibizumab 0.2 мг (Lucentis — RAINBOW Lancet 2019) или bevacizumab 0.625 мг (Avastin — BEAT-ROP NEJM 2011). Laser photocoagulation — alternative для Zone II posterior. Aflibercept (Eylea) — newer option.

questions.q: Type 1 ROP по ETROP — какие критерии?
options: Zone I, любая stage + plus; ИЛИ Zone I, stage 3 без plus; ИЛИ Zone II, stage 2-3 + plus
questions.explanation: Type 1 ROP (treatment indicated, ETROP 2003): (1) Zone I, любая stage с plus disease; (2) Zone I, stage 3 без plus; (3) Zone II, stage 2 или 3 с plus. Treatment within 48-72 ч. Type 2 — close observation.

questions.q: First ROP screen у preterm GA <30 нед?
options: 31 нед PMA OR 4 нед chronologic age (whichever later)
questions.explanation: AAP/AAO 2018: GA <27 нед — 31 нед PMA. GA 27-30 нед — 31 нед PMA OR 4 weeks chronologic. Re-examine каждые 1-3 нед до зрелости retina (zone III + no plus).

questions.q: Type 1 ETROP criteria для treatment?
options: Zone I any stage с plus, OR Zone I stage 3 без plus, OR Zone II stage 2/3 с plus
questions.explanation: Type 1 ROP (требует treatment): Zone I любая stage + plus disease, OR Zone I stage 3 без plus, OR Zone II stage 2/3 с plus. Treat в течение 48-72 ч.

questions.q: Какой treatment first-line для Type 1 ROP?
options: Anti-VEGF intravitreal injection (bevacizumab/ranibizumab) для Zone I disease, laser для Zone II
questions.explanation: BEAT-ROP/RAINBOW trials: anti-VEGF (bevacizumab 0.625 мг IVT, ranibizumab 0.2 мг) — superior к laser для Zone I. Laser standard для Zone II. Cryotherapy historical.

questions.q: Какие risk factors для severe ROP?
options: GA<28 нед + BW<1500 г + supplemental O₂ + sepsis + transfusions + IVH
questions.explanation: ROP risk factors: prematurity (GA<28 нед = main), BW<1500 г, supplemental O₂ (high SpO₂ targets), sepsis, blood transfusions, IVH, BPD, slow growth. Multifactorial.

questions.q: При aggressive ROP (formerly AP-ROP) — что характерно?
options: Rapid progression в zone I-II posterior, severe plus disease, ill-defined demarcation, поражает ELBW
questions.explanation: Aggressive ROP (A-ROP, ICROP3 2021): rapid posterior pole disease с severe plus, ill-defined demarcation между vascular/avascular retina. ELBW (<750 г) particularly at risk. Anti-VEGF preferred.

questions.q: Какой stop criteria для ROP screening?
options: Zone III vascularization OR full mature retina × 2 visits OR post-treatment regression
questions.explanation: Stop ROP screening: full vascularization (zone III, no ROP), 2 consecutive exams. Post-treatment — regression of plus + neovascularization. Re-examine после treatment 1-2 нед.

questions.q: Каков outcome anti-VEGF treated ROP?
options: Effective regression в zone I, но recurrence до 19% — extended follow-up до full vascularization (50+ нед PMA)
questions.explanation: Anti-VEGF: successful regression в Zone I 80-90%. Recurrence до 19% (BEAT-ROP). Continued screening required until full retinal vascularization — may take 50-60 нед PMA. Long-term safety still studied.

questions.q: При Stage 4-5 (retinal detachment) — treatment?
questions.explanation: Stage 4A (extrafoveal detachment) — lens-sparing vitrectomy, decent outcomes. Stage 4B-5 (subtotal/total RD) — complex vitrectomy, often poor visual outcomes. Prevention via timely treatment essential.

questions.q: Какова target SpO₂ у preterm для balancing ROP vs mortality (BOOST/SUPPORT trials)?
options: 91-95% (higher target reduces mortality, accepts modest ROP increase)
questions.explanation: BOOST/SUPPORT pooled: SpO₂ 91-95% target снижает mortality vs 85-89% (lower target had ↑ NEC + mortality). “High” target slightly ↑ ROP/treatment-required ROP. AAP recommends 90-95%.

questions.q: По NIH 2018 классификации, BPD grade 2 (moderate) определяется как:
options: FiO₂ ≥ 0.30 ИЛИ ≥ 1 L/min ИЛИ NIPPV на 36 нед PMA
questions.explanation: BPD grade 2 (moderate) per NIH 2018 (Higgins, Pediatrics 2018): NC FiO₂ ≥ 0.30 ИЛИ ≥ 1 L/min ИЛИ NIPPV на 36 нед PMA. Grade 1 (mild) = FiO₂ 0.21-0.30. Grade 3 (severe) = invasive MV.

questions.q: Какая мера снижает BPD risk у preterm?
questions.explanation: CAP trial (Schmidt 2007) — caffeine citrate early start (≤ 3 d) ↓ BPD 36 % vs 47 % control. Также: ↓ MV duration, ↓ ROP. Permissive O₂ (90-95 %) + gentle MV дополнительно.

questions.q: DART postnatal dexamethasone — preferred у:
options: Preterm < 28 нед на MV ≥ 7-14 d с estimated BPD risk ≥ 50 %
questions.explanation: AAP COFN 2010 framework — postnatal dexamethasone (DART scheme — Doyle 2006 NEJM) reasonable у: < 28 нед, на MV ≥ 7-14 d, estimated BPD risk ≥ 50 % (using prediction tools). Дискуss benefits/risks с family. DART low-dose 0.89 мг/кг over 10 дней.

questions.q: NIH 2018 BPD definition?
options: FiO₂/respiratory support requirement at 36 нед PMA — graded I-III по supplement
questions.explanation: NIH 2018: BPD evaluate at 36 нед PMA (или discharge whichever first). Grade I: nasal cannula <2 LPM или hood ≤0.30 FiO₂; II: ≥2 LPM или ≥0.30 FiO₂; III: invasive PPV или ≥0.30 + nCPAP/NIPPV.

questions.q: Caffeine prophylaxis (CAP trial) — outcome?
options: Снижает BPD, IQ improvement, severe disability у preterm
questions.explanation: CAP trial (Schmidt 2007, follow-up 2017): caffeine 20 мг/кг loading + 5-10 мг/кг maintenance → BPD reduction 36% → 11 yo improved cognitive/motor. Standard of care у GA<32 нед.

questions.q: DART (low-dose dexamethasone) scheme для severe BPD?
options: 0.075 мг/кг/сут × 3 дня, then taper, total 10 days, started after 7-14 дней postnatal у ventilated с BPD risk
questions.explanation: DART (Doyle 2006): низкодозовый dex 0.075 мг/кг/сут разделить q12h × 3 дня, taper to 0.05 → 0.025 → 0.01, total 10 дней. Reduces ventilator support без увеличения CP. Initiated после day 7.

questions.q: Какие main risk factors BPD?
options: Prematurity (<32 нед) + birth weight <1500 g + prolonged O₂/PPV + chorioamnionitis + sepsis + PDA
questions.explanation: BPD risk: GA<32 нед (>50% у GA<28), BW<1500 г, prolonged O₂/PPV, chorioamnionitis (early lung injury), sepsis (postnatal inflammation), hsPDA (volume overload + edema), нутрициальный дефицит.

questions.q: BPD prevention strategies?
options: Antenatal steroids + early CPAP/avoid intubation + caffeine + targeted O₂ (90-95%) + Vitamin A + adequate nutrition
questions.explanation: BPD prevention bundle: antenatal steroids × mat, gentle ventilation (CPAP ± LISA → avoid intubation), caffeine для GA<32 нед, SpO₂ 90-95%, Vitamin A 5000 IU IM 3×/нед, optimal nutrition (protein, calories).

questions.q: При BPD III (требует invasive ventilation на 36 нед) — long-term outcome?
options: Higher risk respiratory morbidity (asthma-like, viral hospitalizations), neurodevelopmental impairment, mortality, growth failure
questions.explanation: BPD III: ↑ risk severe respiratory morbidity (asthma), recurrent viral hospitalizations, NDD (CP, cognitive impairment), growth failure (additional caloric needs), pulmonary HTN. Mortality elevated.

questions.q: При BPD-PHTN — diagnostic test?
options: Echocardiogram (RV hypertrophy, septal flattening, TR jet, pulmonary artery pressure)
questions.explanation: BPD-PHTN: echo screen at 36 нед PMA OR earlier при clinical suspicion (hypoxia despite O₂, RV strain). Findings: RVH, IVS flattening, TR jet, RV dilation. Catheterization gold standard если significant.

questions.q: Какой diuretic adjunct в severe BPD (not first-line)?
options: Chronic diuretic (furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide+spironolactone) — limited evidence, used selectively с CHF/edema
questions.explanation: Chronic diuretics в BPD — controversial: improve oxygenation short-term, no long-term benefit established. Reserved для severe BPD с edema/CHF/pulmonary congestion. Furosemide nephrocalcinosis risk.

questions.q: Какова mortality severe BPD discharged on home O₂?
questions.explanation: BPD severe (home O₂) post-discharge mortality 5-15% к 2 yo. Causes: viral infections (RSV preventable via palivizumab), pulmonary HTN crises, sudden death. Multidisciplinary follow-up essential.

questions.q: Treatment threshold у symptomatic newborn в первые 4 ч жизни (PES 2015):
questions.explanation: PES 2015 thresholds (Thornton J Pediatr 2015): первые 4 ч жизни → < 1.7 ммоль/л symptomatic ИЛИ < 1.4 asymptomatic. 4-24 ч → < 2.2. > 24 ч → < 2.5. > 48 ч persistent → < 3.3 (workup IEM/CHI).

questions.q: Workup persistent hypoglycemia > 48 ч жизни — какие критические samples?
options: Insulin, c-peptide, β-OH-butyrate, FFA, GH, cortisol, ammonia (during hypoglycemia)
questions.explanation: Critical sample (during low glucose < 2.5): insulin > 2 µE/мл (CHI), c-peptide, β-OH-butyrate (low в CHI vs high IEM), FFA (suppressed CHI), GH, cortisol (rule out adrenal insufficiency), ammonia (high в GLUD1 hyperinsulinism+hyperammonemia syndrome).

questions.q: Glucagon stimulation test — какой response указывает на CHI?
questions.explanation: Glucagon stimulation test: 0.03 мг/кг IM/IV during hypoglycemia. Glucose ↑ > 1.6 ммоль/л в 30 мин = positive (CHI characteristic — adequate glycogen stores + insulin-driven). IEM other (glycogen storage disease, fatty acid oxidation defects) → no response.

questions.q: PES 2015 hypoglycemia threshold для symptomatic newborn (term, <24 ч)?
options: <2.6 ммоль/л (47 мг/дл) — symptomatic OR <2.0 asymptomatic первые 4 ч
questions.explanation: PES 2015: при symptoms BG <2.6 ммоль/л (47 мг/дл) — treat. Asymptomatic first 4 ч <2.0 — feed/D10. После 24 ч target ≥2.8-3.3 ммоль/л.

questions.q: BAPM 2017 threshold (UK)?
questions.explanation: BAPM 2017: at-risk infants (preterm, IDM, SGA, LGA) BG <2.0 ммоль/л — management trigger. ≥2.0 acceptable. Different thresholds vs PES (2.6) for symptomatic.

questions.q: При persistent hypoglycemia после 48 ч — критическое sample?
options: BG + insulin + C-peptide + cortisol + GH + ketones + free fatty acids + lactate + ammonia при event hypoglycemia
questions.explanation: Critical sample при BG<2.6 ммоль/л: insulin, C-peptide, cortisol, GH, beta-hydroxybutyrate, FFA, lactate, ammonia, urine ketones, urine reducing substances. Helps differentiate causes (HI vs cortisol/GH deficiency vs FAOD).

questions.q: Glucagon stimulation test — when и интерпретация?
options: При persistent hypoglycemia: glucagon 0.03 mg/kg IV/IM — BG rise ≥2 ммоль/л = preserved liver glycogen + insulin excess (HI)
questions.explanation: Glucagon stim test: BG rise ≥30 мг/дл (1.7 ммоль/л) после glucagon = inappropriate insulin secretion (HI). HI confirmed: detectable insulin (>2 µIU/mL) при hypoglycemia + low FFA/ketones.

questions.q: Hyperinsulinism (HI) treatment first-line?
questions.explanation: Diazoxide — first-line congenital HI: opens K-ATP channel → inhibits insulin release. Doses 5-15 мг/кг/сут q8h. Side effects: fluid retention, hypertrichosis. Failure response → octreotide.

questions.q: Glucose bolus при symptomatic hypoglycemia (BG<2.6)?
options: 2 мл/кг D10 IV bolus, then GIR 6-8 мг/кг/мин continuous
questions.explanation: Mini-dextrose 2 мл/кг D10 IV → 200 мг/кг → BG rise. Затем continuous GIR 6-8 мг/кг/мин. NEVER D50 (peripheral vein → phlebitis). Recheck BG через 30 мин.

questions.q: Какие риски HIE при severe hypoglycemia?
options: Long-term neurodevelopmental impairment + occipital lobe injury (MRI)
questions.explanation: Severe/recurrent hypoglycemia (<1.0 ммоль/л + symptoms): occipital lobe injury (MRI hyperintensity), neurodevelopmental impairment, learning disability. Tight glycemic control critical у at-risk.

questions.q: Hyperglycemia threshold у preterm?
questions.explanation: Hyperglycemia preterm: BG >10 ммоль/л (180 мг/дл). Causes: stress, sepsis, excessive GIR, immature insulin response. Management: lower GIR (но not <4), insulin reserved для persistent BG>14 ммоль/л.

questions.q: Какова частота transient neonatal hypoglycemia у at-risk newborn (IDM, LGA, SGA, preterm)?
questions.explanation: IDM hypoglycemia 60-80% (transient HI). LGA 30-50%, SGA 30%, preterm 10-15%. Most resolve в первые 24-48 ч с feeds. Persistent (>48 ч) → workup для congenital HI.

questions.q: Profilaktika VKDB — какая dose preferred?
questions.explanation: AAP 2022 + WHO: 1 мг IM Vit K в первые 6 ч жизни — стандарт всем. < 1500 г preterm: 0.5 мг IM. PO alternative (2 мг at birth + 2 мг 1 нед + 2 мг 4 нед) — менее эффективна, особенно для late VKDB.

questions.q: PlaNeT-2 (NEJM 2019) — рекомендуемый platelet transfusion threshold у asymptomatic stable preterm:
questions.explanation: PlaNeT-2 — restrictive 25 × 10⁹/л preferred over liberal 50 × 10⁹/л. Liberal threshold ↑ death/major bleeding (Curley NEJM 2019). Asymptomatic + risk факторы (MV, sepsis, IVH, surgery в next 12-24 ч) → < 50. Symptomatic bleeding → транфузия при ANY count.

questions.q: NAIT (Neonatal Alloimmune Thrombocytopenia) — preferred первая линия?
options: Maternal или HPA-matched platelets + IVIG 1 г/кг
questions.explanation: NAIT — antibodies destroy fetal platelets. Maternal или HPA-matched platelets preferred (won't be destroyed). IVIG 1 г/кг daily × 2-5 d blocks Fc receptors. Random donor platelets — bridge until matched available. ICH risk до 20 % untreated severe NAIT.

questions.q: Vitamin K1 prophylaxis для VKDB — dose?
questions.explanation: VKDB prevention: 1 мг IM × 1 в первый час (BW>1000 г), 0.5 мг IM (<1000 г). PO regimens — less effective, multiple doses needed. IM single dose protects all 3 forms VKDB (early/classic/late).

questions.q: Late VKDB — when и presentation?
options: 2-12 нед, exclusively breastfed без vitamin K, intracranial hemorrhage common
questions.explanation: Late VKDB (2-12 нед): exclusively breastfed (BM low в vit K) без prophylaxis, often с liver disease/malabsorption. Intracranial hemorrhage 50-80% → mortality 15-25%, neuro sequelae у survivors.

questions.q: PlaNeT-2 trial threshold для платочкной transfusion у preterm?
options: Plt < 25,000 для prophylactic transfusion (lower threshold reduces death/major bleed)
questions.explanation: PlaNeT-2 (Curley NEJM 2019): prophylactic platelet transfusion при Plt<25k (vs <50k) → less death + major bleeding в preterm. Active bleeding: keep Plt >50k. Surgery: >100k.

questions.q: NAIT (neonatal alloimmune thrombocytopenia) — pathogenesis?
options: Maternal antibodies против paternal-derived platelet antigens (HPA-1a most common 80%)
questions.explanation: NAIT: maternal IgG antibodies против paternal platelet antigens. HPA-1a (PlA1) — 80% case Caucasians. Severe thrombocytopenia (<50k common, often <20k). ICH 10-20%, may be antenatal (in utero).

questions.q: При NAIT с severe thrombocytopenia + bleeding — treatment?
options: HPA-compatible platelets (PLA1-negative), IVIG 1 г/кг × 1-2 doses, methylpred PRN
questions.explanation: NAIT severe (Plt<30k или bleeding): HPA-1a-negative (or maternal washed) platelets — preferred. IVIG 1 г/кг q24h 1-2 doses + methylpred. Random platelets — if HPA-typed not immediately available, transient response.

questions.q: Disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) у newborn — labs?
options: PT/aPTT prolonged + fibrinogen low + D-dimer elevated + thrombocytopenia + schistocytes
questions.explanation: DIC labs: ↑PT/aPTT, ↓fibrinogen (<150 мг/дл), ↑D-dimer, thrombocytopenia, schistocytes на blood smear. Score-based diagnosis (ISTH). Treat underlying (sepsis, asphyxia) + replace (FFP, cryo, plt).

questions.q: Стартовая doza FFP для coagulopathy?
questions.explanation: FFP 10-15 мл/кг IV — corrects mild-moderate coagulopathy. Repeat q8-12h PRN. Cryoprecipitate 10 мл/кг для fibrinogen <100 мг/дл. PCC reserved для severe bleeding с known factor deficits.

questions.q: При hemophilia A confirmed у newborn boy с family history — ICH risk?
options: 1-4% ICH risk — avoid IM injections, vaginal delivery if possible, factor VIII при bleeding
questions.explanation: Severe hemophilia A: ICH risk 1-4% perinatal. Recommend C-section при positive family history (controversial). NO IM injections (use SC or oral для vit K). Factor VIII если bleeding (50 IU/кг IV → 100% activity).

questions.q: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) у newborn?
options: Rare in newborn (<1%) — different antigen presentation; heparin alternative agents argatroban
questions.explanation: HIT редко в neonates (<1%). Если suspect: discontinue heparin, switch на argatroban (direct thrombin inhibitor) или bivalirudin. Не давать LMWH/fondaparinux при HIT (cross-reactivity).

questions.q: Hyperoxia test: PaO₂ < 100 на 100 % FiO₂ × 10 мин — какая диф diагноз?
questions.explanation: Hyperoxia test: 100 % O₂ × 10 мин → ABG. Pulmonary cause: PaO₂ ≥ 150 (significant rise). Cardiac cause: PaO₂ < 100 (no rise — fixed shunting). Equivocal 100-150 → echo. PGE1 0.05-0.1 мкг/кг/мин при подозрении ductal-dependent CHD.

questions.q: Cold shock у newborn — preferred первый-line vasoactive agent:
questions.explanation: Cold shock (low CO + high SVR): epinephrine 0.05-0.3 мкг/кг/мин — first-line (β1 inotropic dose). Warm shock (high CO + low SVR): noradrenaline first-line. Vasopressin для catecholamine-resistant warm shock. SSC Pediatric 2020.

questions.q: Pre-ductal SpO₂ значительно ниже post-ductal (reverse differential) — какой Dx?
questions.explanation: Reverse differential (post-ductal SpO₂ > pre-ductal) — characteristic для TGA с restrictive PFO + critical PDA. Aorta receives deoxygenated blood (от RV-aorta), pulmonary artery receives oxygenated (от LV-PA). PDA crucial — PGE1 immediate.

questions.q: Hyperoxia test при подозрении cyanotic CHD?
options: 100% O₂ × 5 мин, ABG — PaO₂ <100 → cyanotic CHD vs >150 → lung disease
100% O₂ × 10-15 мин, ABG — PaO₂ <150 → cyanotic CHD; >150 → lung disease
questions.explanation: Hyperoxia test: 100% FiO₂ × 10-15 мин, ABG. PaO₂ (right radial) <150 (часто <100) → cyanotic CHD (R-to-L shunting). >150 → lung pathology. <50 — PPHN или severe lung disease.

questions.q: Reverse differential SpO₂ (foot > right hand) — суgering?
options: Transposition of great arteries (TGA) с PPHN — R-to-L PDA shunt directing oxygenated blood к lower extremities
questions.explanation: Reverse differential SpO₂ (foot > RH) — pathognomonic для TGA с PPHN: through PDA blood from systemic R-to-L shunt directs oxygenated to lower body (descending aorta). Stat echo + start PGE1.

questions.q: Cold (vasoconstricted) shock — типичные signs?
options: Cold extremities, prolonged CR (>3-4 sec), narrow pulse pressure, hypotension late
questions.explanation: Cold shock: vasoconstricted, peripheral hypoperfusion (cool extremities, mottled), prolonged capillary refill, narrow pulse pressure. Common in newborns. Treatment: fluids ± inotropes (dopamine → epinephrine).

questions.q: Warm shock — signs + treatment?
options: Vasodilated, bounding pulses, wide pulse pressure, warm extremities — vasopressin/norepinephrine
questions.explanation: Warm shock: vasodilated (warm extremities), bounding pulses, wide pulse pressure, low SVR. Common late sepsis. Vasopressors: norepinephrine first OR vasopressin (selective vasoconstrictor) если refractory.

questions.q: Stat treatment cyanotic CHD newborn?
options: PGE1 0.05-0.1 мкг/кг/мин IV (maintains PDA patency) + cardiology consult + transfer
questions.explanation: Cyanotic CHD presumed (failed hyperoxia, decompensation): PGE1 (Prostin) 0.05-0.1 мкг/кг/мин IV continuous. Maintains DA patency. Side effects: apnea (be ready to intubate), fever, jitteriness.

questions.q: При duct-dependent congenital heart lesion — closing PDA produces?
options: Cardiovascular collapse, profound cyanosis, metabolic acidosis, hypotension, death
questions.explanation: Duct-dependent lesions (HLHS, IAA, critical AS, TGA without VSD, pulmonary atresia): PDA closure → obstruction systemic/pulmonary blood flow → cardiovascular collapse, severe acidosis, death без PGE1.

questions.q: Какова empiric ABX для presumed septic shock в newborn?
options: Ампициллин + гентамицин (early-onset) OR vanco + cefepime (late-onset) — широкий спектр + early administration <1 hr
questions.explanation: Septic shock newborn: empiric ABX в течение 1 ч (every 1-h delay ↑ mortality). EOS: amp + gent. LOS: vanco + cefepime/gent. Tailor culture-driven. Adjunct: fluids 10-20 мл/кг bolus, inotropes, hydrocortisone refractory.

questions.q: Какие метаболические abnormalities у septic shock newborn?
options: Lactic acidosis + hypoglycemia + electrolyte derangements + DIC
questions.explanation: Septic shock metabolic: lactic acidosis (hypoperfusion), hypoglycemia (depleted glycogen), Na/K disturbance, hypocalcemia, DIC. Monitor glucose, lactate, ABG, electrolytes, coags q4-6h initially.

questions.q: Refractory hypotension despite fluids + 2 inotropes — next step?
options: Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг IV q6-8h (relative adrenal insufficiency) + workup для obstructive shock (PE, tamponade), CHD
questions.explanation: Catecholamine-resistant shock: hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q6-8h IV (relative adrenal insufficiency у septic preterm). Workup: echo для tamponade/PE/CHD, lactate trend, perfusion. Add vasopressin для warm shock.

questions.q: Adequate respiratory drive marker для extubation у preterm на synchronized vent:
options: FiO₂ ≤ 0.30, PEEP ≤ 5, set rate ≤ 15-20/мин, spontaneous TV ≥ 4 мл/кг
questions.explanation: Extubation readiness criteria: FiO₂ ≤ 0.30, PEEP ≤ 5, set rate ≤ 15-20/мин (если synchronized), spontaneous tidal volume ≥ 4 мл/кг, PIP ≤ 18-20, pH > 7.25, PaCO₂ < 55-60, no inotropes ≥ 24 ч. SBT helpful.

questions.q: Какая post-extubation поддержка preferred у preterm < 1000 г для уменьшения re-intubation?
questions.explanation: Lemyre Cochrane 2017:CD003212 — NIPPV preferred over CPAP для < 1000 g post-extubation. ↓ Re-intubation rate, ↓ BPD. Either acceptable для > 1000 g. Caffeine citrate critical — start 24-48 ч pre-extubation если not already on.

questions.q: Extubation readiness criteria для preterm <1000 г?
options: MAP ≤7-8, FiO₂ ≤0.30, RR<60, no significant apnea, hemodynamic stability, weight gain
questions.explanation: Extubation readiness: MAP ≤7-8 cm H₂O, FiO₂ ≤0.30, RR <60 spontaneous, normal pH/PCO₂, hemodynamic stable, weight gain, on caffeine. Spontaneous breathing trial (SBT) optional.

questions.q: Optimal post-extubation support у ELBW (<1000 г)?
options: NIPPV (non-invasive PPV) reduces re-intubation vs NCPAP в ELBW
questions.explanation: Cochrane meta-analysis: NIPPV (synchronized или non-syn) > NCPAP в ELBW для preventing re-intubation. Settings: PIP 16-18, PEEP 5-6, RR 10-30. Каффеин с loading доза 20 мг/кг до extubation.

questions.q: Caffeine loading dose до extubation?
questions.explanation: Caffeine loading 20 мг/кг IV/PO в течение 30-60 мин до planned extubation, далее maintenance 5-10 мг/кг q24h. Snizhayet apnea of prematurity, BPD, improves extubation success.

questions.q: При chest X-ray до extubation — что искать?
options: Atelectasis, BPD pattern, ETT position, residual RDS, pneumothorax — assess parenchymal status
questions.explanation: Pre-extubation CXR (если recent): atelectasis (recruit?), BPD pattern, ETT position. Не routine. Failed extubation common причины: atelectasis, persistent BPD, neurological apnea, sepsis, hsPDA.

questions.q: Spontaneous breathing trial (SBT) — settings + duration?
questions.explanation: SBT preterm: ETT-CPAP 5-6 cm H₂O 30 мин (or T-piece). Tolerated SBT predicts extubation success. Не universally adopted в preterm — protocols vary; weight-based protocol common.

questions.q: Failed extubation rates у preterm ELBW?
questions.explanation: ELBW failed extubation 30-40%. Causes: atelectasis, BPD progression, apnea, hsPDA, sepsis, exhaustion. Recent failure не contra повторных extubations — try optimization (caffeine loading, post-extubation NIPPV).

questions.q: Post-extubation stridor / upper airway obstruction — management?
options: Racemic epinephrine nebulizer 0.5 мл of 2.25% в 3 мл NaCl + dexamethasone 0.5 мг/кг IV; reintubate если no response
questions.explanation: Subglottic edema (stridor): racemic epi nebulizer + dexamethasone IV 0.5 мг/кг. Если persistent stridor + respiratory distress → reintubation, ENT consult, possible bronchoscopy.

questions.q: Когда extubate на high-flow nasal cannula vs NCPAP/NIPPV?
options: HFNC может быть substitute для NCPAP в late preterm/term, но в ELBW NIPPV/NCPAP — preferred
questions.explanation: HFNC у preterm: comparable к NCPAP в late preterm/moderate preterm для prevent reintubation. ELBW: NIPPV first-line. HFNC easier нос-care, less septal trauma. Choose by individual response.

questions.q: При prolonged intubation (>14 day) у preterm — what risk?
options: BPD progression, subglottic stenosis, infection (VAP), nutritional impact, neurological
questions.explanation: Prolonged intubation risks: BPD progression (volutrauma/biotrauma), VAP, subglottic stenosis (5-10% post extubation у preterm), feeding intolerance (sedation), neurological impact. Aggressive de-escalation важен.

questions.q: При re-intubation — какие optimal sedation/analgesia?
options: Морфин 0.05-0.1 мг/кг + atropine 0.02 мг/кг + suxamethonium ИЛИ rocuronium для RSI — минимизирует bradycardia/desat
questions.explanation: Premedicated intubation: opioid (fentanyl 1-2 мкг/кг или morphine 0.05-0.1 мг/кг) + atropine 0.02 мг/кг (анти-vagal) + paralytic (rocuronium 0.6 мг/кг или suxamethonium 1-2 мг/кг). Reduces bradycardia, desats, ICP rises.

questions.q: CCHD pulse oximetry screen — критерии 'fail':
options: SpO₂ < 90 % ИЛИ persistent < 95 % после 3 measurements + 1 ч ИЛИ ≥ 3 % difference
questions.explanation: AAP/AHA Pediatrics 2011:e1259 — fail criteria: SpO₂ < 90 % (любая измерение); ИЛИ persistent < 95 % после 3 measurements + 1 ч; ИЛИ ≥ 3 % difference между pre + post-ductal. Fail → ECHO obligatory. Pass: ≥ 95 % обеих сторон AND difference < 3 %.

questions.q: Preferred timing CCHD screen:
questions.explanation: CCHD screen 24-48 ч жизни — после transitional circulation completed. Слишком ранний (< 24 ч) → false positives (PFO, PDA still patent). Для term + late preterm ≥ 35 нед. Sensitivity ~75 % для critical CHD missed prenatally.

questions.q: CCHD pulse oximetry screening — когда?
questions.explanation: AAP-CCHD: pulse oxим screen 24-48 ч жизни. До 24 ч — transitional circulation → false-positives 1.6%. После 24 ч — 0.4%. Универсальный screening since 2011 в США.

questions.q: Pulse ox sites?
questions.explanation: CCHD screen: pre-ductal (RH) + post-ductal (foot). Differential >3% suggests R-to-L PDA shunt (cyanotic CHD with low post-ductal SpO₂) or reverse differential (TGA + PPHN).

questions.q: Failed CCHD screen criteria?
options: SpO₂<90% любой site, OR <95% оба site × 3 measurements 1 hr apart, OR ≥3% разница RH vs foot × 3
questions.explanation: Failed: SpO₂<90% любой site immediately, OR <95% оба site × 3 1-hr-apart measurements, OR ≥3% разница RH vs foot × 3. Failed → stat echo + cardiology.

questions.q: Какие CHDs caught by pulse ox screening?
options: Cyanotic CHDs primarily: HLHS, TGA, TOF, total anomalous venous return, tricuspid atresia, truncus, pulmonary atresia (~7 critical lesions)
questions.explanation: Pulse ox screening targets 7 critical CHDs causing hypoxia: HLHS, TGA, TOF, total anomalous pulmonary venous return, tricuspid atresia, truncus arteriosus, pulmonary atresia. Coarctation — не reliably detected.

questions.q: Sensitivity pulse ox screening для critical CHD?
options: ~76% (combined с antenatal echo + clinical exam — overall ~85-90%)
questions.explanation: Pulse ox alone sensitivity ~76% (Thangaratinam 2012 Cochrane). Combined screening (fetal echo + postnatal exam + pulse ox) — 85-90%. Coarctation, AS — missed by pulse ox.

questions.q: При positive screen — workup?
options: Stat echocardiogram (best ASAP) + cardiology eval; CXR + ECG могут add
questions.explanation: Failed pulse ox → stat echo (gold standard для CHD diagnosis), cardiology consult. CXR/ECG complementary. Если echo normal — evaluate for sepsis, lung disease, methemoglobinemia.

questions.q: False-positive причины pulse ox screen?
options: Sepsis, lung disease (RDS, MAS, pneumothorax), persistent fetal circulation/PPHN, met-Hb, screen <24 ч (transition)
questions.explanation: False-positive причины: sepsis, RDS/MAS/pneumothorax, PPHN, met-Hb, motion artifact, screening <24 ч (transitional circulation). Каждый failed — echocardiogram + comprehensive eval.

questions.q: Antenatal CHD detection rate в эру routine 2D + Doppler echocardiography?
options: 30-50% общих CHD; 60-70% major/critical CHD при experienced operator
questions.explanation: Antenatal echo CHD detection: 30-50% all CHD, 60-70% critical/major (HLHS, complete AVSD). Quality dependent on operator/equipment. Improving с time. Не replace postnatal screen.

questions.q: При CCHD diagnosed prenatally — delivery management?
options: Plan delivery в tertiary center с cardiac surgical capability + neonatology + cardiology
questions.explanation: Prenatal CHD: deliver в quaternary center с cardiac surgery (PCICU), pediatric cardiology, NICU. Avoid transport critical newborn. Plan PGE1 на стол если duct-dependent. Multidisciplinary planning.

questions.q: Какова mortality untreated critical CHD без screening?
questions.explanation: Critical CHD untreated mortality 30-40% в первые недели/месяцы (sudden death post-discharge при closing PDA). Pulse ox screen early detection + treatment → mortality reduction by 60% за screened CHDs.

questions.q: Modified Finnegan score ≥ какое значение × consecutive starts pharmacotherapy?
questions.explanation: Modified Finnegan: 21 параметр, q3-4h scoring. Score ≥ 8 × 3 consecutive triggers pharmacotherapy. Score 8-12 → start morphine 0.04-0.08 мг/кг q3-4h. Score > 12 → higher initial dose. ESC alternative — functional approach (Eat, Sleep, Console).

questions.q: BBORN trial 2017 (Kraft NEJM): buprenorphine vs morphine у NAS — primary result:
options: Bupr equivalent + ↓ length of treatment + ↓ LOS
questions.explanation: BBORN trial (Kraft NEJM 2017): buprenorphine sublingual 4-5 мкг/кг q8h vs morphine. Length of treatment 15 d (bupr) vs 28 d (morphine) — 47 % reduction. LOS 21 d vs 33 d. Equivalent safety. Bupr partial μ-agonist = ceiling effect, less respiratory depression.

questions.q: Modified Finnegan score (MOTHER NAS) — pharmacological treatment threshold?
questions.explanation: Modified Finnegan/MOTHER NAS: pharm treatment если score ≥8 × 3 consecutive (q3-4h) OR ≥12 × 2 consecutive. Non-pharm bundling first (skin-to-skin, breastfeeding, swaddling, low-stim environment).

questions.q: Eat-Sleep-Console (ESC) approach — что оценивает?
options: Functional assessment: ребёнок eats ≥1 oz, sleeps ≥1 hour, consoles ≤10 min — три критерия
questions.explanation: ESC: function-based vs symptom-tally. Treat если не достигает: eat ≥1 oz formula или 10 мин breastfeeding, sleep ≥1 ч undisturbed, console ≤10 мин. Reduced LOS, opioid use vs Finnegan-driven по several studies.

questions.q: First-line pharmacotherapy NAS?
options: Morphine PO 0.04-0.1 мг/кг q3-4h (titrate); methadone alternative; buprenorphine emerging
questions.explanation: AAP first-line NAS: morphine PO 0.04-0.1 мг/кг q3-4h, titrate. Methadone — alternative (longer half-life, q6-12h). Buprenorphine SL — emerging (BBORN trial: shorter LOS vs morphine). Clonidine adjunct (α2-agonist).

questions.q: BBORN trial (buprenorphine vs morphine) outcome?
options: Sublingual buprenorphine — shorter treatment duration + LOS vs morphine у NAS opioid-exposed
questions.explanation: BBORN (Kraft NEJM 2017): SL buprenorphine — median treatment duration 15 дней vs 28 (morphine), LOS 21 vs 33 дней. Shorter duration + less drug exposure. Becoming standard в NAS centers.

questions.q: Maternal opioid use disorder — NAS rate?
options: 55-94% всех opioid-exposed neonates develop NAS, varies by drug + dose
questions.explanation: NAS rate: methadone-exposed 60-80%, buprenorphine 50-60%, heroin 50-80%, prescription opioids variable. Time onset varies (heroin 24-48 ч, methadone 3-7 дней, buprenorphine 1-4 дня).

questions.q: Non-pharmacological care bundles?
options: Skin-to-skin, breastfeeding, low-stim environment (dim, quiet), swaddling, rooming-in, parent involvement, gentle care
questions.explanation: Non-pharm NAS bundle: maternal rooming-in, skin-to-skin, breastfeeding (exclusive если no contraindication, e.g., HIV or polysubstance), swaddling, low-stim environment, pacifier. Snizhayet need pharm treatment 30-50%.

questions.q: Какое co-substance использование maternal worsens NAS?
options: Tobacco, benzodiazepines, SSRIs, polysubstance — ↑ severity, atypical presentation
questions.explanation: Co-substance: tobacco — worsens (lower BW + neurotoxicity), benzodiazepines + opioids — prolonged + atypical (sedation alternating с irritability), SSRIs — hyperactivity, jitteriness. Polypharm common.

questions.q: Discharge criteria NAS-treated newborn?
options: Stable off pharm × 24-48 ч, adequate feeding/weight gain, follow-up arranged (developmental, social, peds)
questions.explanation: NAS discharge: pharm treatment off × 24-48 ч without rescue, adequate feeding (not too sleepy), weight gain trajectory, social work eval, pediatric follow-up + developmental clinic, наркорегистр if applicable.

questions.q: Какие long-term outcomes NAS-exposed children?
options: ↑ risk neurodevelopmental delay, ADHD, learning difficulties, behavioral disorders — multifactorial (drug ± social environment)
questions.explanation: NAS long-term: ↑ risk delays language, motor, ADHD, learning. Multifactorial — prenatal drug exposure + post-natal social stressors + parental relationship. Wraparound services (PT/OT, behavioral health, social work) improve outcomes.

questions.q: Какие заболевания screen у NAS у matери с opioid use?
options: HIV + Hepatitis B/C + STI screen + tobacco + co-substances + social work + psych eval
questions.explanation: Maternal/neonatal screening при OUD: HIV + HepB + HepC + RPR/syphilis + chlamydia/gonorrhea, urine toxicology, tobacco, depression screen, social work, custody planning. Постдоставкa: HepB vaccine + immunoglobulin if HBsAg+, HIV treatment guidelines if maternal+.
